facts.fact: New Era reports NCRST launched the National AI Institute in Windhoek, with research, software, datasets and AI innovation centres, and that it is working towards developing high-quality Namibian datasets.
New Era reports NCRST has funded two high-performance computing centres, at the Namibia University of Science and Technology and the University of Namibia, including GPU-enabled capacity.
